postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

constraints: constraint:physics_region_no_evo_import — the guard must not import anything from src/evo_predictor or src/latent_power
Pre-Ruling 1 — bounded fix only: cap threads, no estimator/fit/smoother logic change
Pre-Ruling 2 — the cap is unconditional (not isatty-gated) and uses os.environ.setdefault so an operator's explicit override is respected
Do not commit data/*.db (#632) — git checkout -- data/ after any fit run

structural: struct:src/physics/__init__.py — physics package root, executes before any src.physics.<submodule> import (Python parent-package-first import order)
struct:src/evo_predictor/run.py:26-38 — the shipped #623 fix, the pattern to mirror exactly
struct:scripts/nuisance_sensitivity.py — the named physics-fit repro entrypoint
capability: capability:headless-physics-fit — a physics estimator fit (nuisance_sensitivity.py, load_quali_session, layer2/estimate_store.py-adjacent paths) must complete when launched with no controlling console/window-station
constraint: assumption:openblas-lazy-thread-init — OpenBLAS/MKL's native thread pool inits lazily on first heavy BLAS call, not eagerly at `import numpy`; UNVERIFIED by this plan, must be settled empirically by this gate's before/after repro (see CRITIC_RESULT.md)
decision: decision: guard placed once at src/physics/__init__.py (Candidate A over Candidate B), converged in PLAN_ALTERNATIVES.md, re-confirmed post-critic in CRITIC_RESULT.md
evidence: claim: run.py:26-38 already carries the #623 guard shape (verified by cold critic against source)
claim: no src/physics/** module imports torch (verified by cold critic, grep empty)

claim: 48 of 51 physics-touching scripts under scripts/ import numpy/pandas before any src.physics submodule (verified by commander repo-wide grep) — this is why the fix must be verified by REAL reproduction, not asserted safe by import-order inspection alone
confidence_flags: assumption:openblas-lazy-thread-init is the single load-bearing unverified claim the whole plan rests on — this gate's implement task MUST attempt a real before/after hang reproduction (Pre-Ruling 3) rather than treating the fix as self-evidently correct from import-order reasoning alone; if the post-fix repro still hangs, STOP short of claiming FIXED and follow the Honest-Null Clause (diagnose the true blocking call, float a wider recommendation) rather than silently expanding to per-script patches across 48 files

g1-integrate.title: Cap headless BLAS/OMP/torch threads at the physics-region import seam: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Check the REVIEW_RESULT verdict. APPROVE: run the verification command yourself (do not trust the claim), confirm postconditions pass, advance this gate. BLOCK: send the implementer back for rework or raise a blocker if the gate is unresolvable. Log any out-of-scope finds as triage candidates (e.g. a run.py-calls-the-shared-guard consolidation, or extending the guard to a process-wrapper if the lazy-init assumption is falsified).
